title: A tie broken by the writer's name
request:
an untouched register, then two writes carrying the same timestamp

./your_program.sh lww-register
value r1
set r1 red 7
set r2 blue 7
value r1
note: Wall clocks tie more often than anyone expects, and two replicas that resolve a tie differently have diverged permanently. The rule has to be a total order on data both sides already hold, so the name rides along with the value.

title: An element removed and added again
request:
one element added, removed, then added a second time

./your_program.sh or-set
add r1 x
remove r1 x
elements r1
add r1 x
elements r1
note: The second add has to mint a tag the remove never saw. A set that remembers removed *elements* rather than removed *tags* answers the empty set here and can never be talked out of it.
